notes.title: Update notes for 4/14/2024
notes.notes:
Long time no see! Here is a super small patch with some super small changes:

 Reduced the amount of crystals needed to complete the no-damage, crystal challenge in All Monsters Easy
 Reduced the amount of crystals needed to complete the no-damage, crystal challenge in Bouncing Mania

notes.title: Update notes for 4/30/2021
notes.notes:
This update fixes a few bugs that were mentioned in the bug thread:

The guide circle and line no longer disappear when reviving
Wave modes no longer display "Play" between waves

A few additional non-bug related changes were made:

Reduced the crystal sizes to improve visibility
Increased the attack circle a little bit to make it easier to hit enemies

notes.title: Update notes for 4/18/2021
notes.notes:
This update adds two new features that did not make it into the previous update.


-New music added for the lobby
-Small tutorial mode added for new players. This mode replaces the old menu that briefly explained the controls. You can activate this mode by reselecting a language of your choice

In addition to these features, a few visual changes were made to better fit the new font.

notes.title: Update Notes for 4/15/2021
notes.notes:
Sorry for the late update!
This patch adds a few features and changes that were requested by some players:


Official localization support for Japanese and Russian
Native gamepad support
You can skip through the score review screen by clicking the screen
You can toggle between windowed and full-screen mode
Maps are cheaper
The magic secret room is now accessible even if you don't have all the magic bullets
Improved the accuracy of the hit circle (it should be easier to hit enemies now)

Please contact me if there are any bugs.
